munit:test.name: null_line_items_test
munit:test.description: payload.lineItems is null should not silently produce a fake invoice

munit:test.name: empty_line_items_array_test
munit:test.description: an order with an empty lineItems array should produce a zero-value invoice

munit:test.name: all_line_items_cancelled_test
munit:test.description: every line item cancelled should behave the same as an empty array

munit:test.name: type_mismatch_quantity_as_string_test
munit:test.description: quantity provided as a string instead of a number should be a clear type mismatch error, not a silent miscalculation

munit:test.name: boundary_zero_quantity_test
munit:test.description: a confirmed line item with quantity 0 is a boundary value that should contribute 0 to the subtotal without erroring

munit:test.name: boundary_large_unit_price_test
munit:test.description: a very large unitPrice is a boundary value that should still round correctly to 2 decimal places
